data.title: Diamonds crash to lowest prices this century as Bitcoin surges past them
data.description: Natural diamond values have slid to levels not seen in over two decades, with wholesale prices sitting roughly 30-40% below their 2021 peaks.Retail prices for a mainstream 1-carat natural round diamond now land between $3,530 and $3,860.
